title: Polynomial-time SAT with small satisfying weak backdoors at any fixed clause width
claims: SmallWeakBackdoorSATInP works for every fixed number of branch index bits, giving a language in the exact reference P contained in SAT and complete for the stated bounded-width weak-backdoor promise.
The branching program uses a verified constant-depth binary name selector and a parameterized measured iteration. It does not take an auxiliary backdoor list.
P_subset_NP is separately checked against the exact pinned definitions.

experiments.purpose: Run the pinned reference checker where available. Otherwise compare source hashes with the submitted checker transcript, without awarding experimental Lean points.
